summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of unitxt global SMS/WhatsApp messaging platform. Fixed critical useEffect bug causing 'destroy is not a function' error across 13 admin/client/reseller pages. All 3 portals (Admin, Client, Reseller) now working correctly with dark command-center aesthetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal close button (✕) is intercepted by sticky header z-index when modal is open
ui_bugs.workaround: Click outside modal or press Escape to close

action_items: OPTIONAL: Fix modal z-index to be above sticky header (z-50 vs z-30)
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: useEffect(load, []) pattern was causing 'destroy is not a function' error - changed to useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) in 13 files
All interactive elements have proper data-testid attributes
Dark theme consistently applied across all pages
JetBrains Mono used for numeric values, Manrope for headings as specified
Tracing beam active state working on sidebar navigation

bugs_fixed.bug: TypeError: destroy is not a function
bugs_fixed.root_cause: useEffect(load, []) pattern - React expects cleanup function but load() returns a Promise
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to useEffect(() => { load(); }, []) in 13 files
